The main takeaway from our work is that
hard example mining is a relative concept. It should be defined relative to the whole model set instead of a single model.
hard example mining can be improved by ensembling multiple models with different complexities.
hard example mining is not a one-time process, but a continuous and dynamic one, and the hard level of each sample is relative to the model complexity.
